title: WHERE in the World?
subtitle: Filter the e-commerce chaos to find what matters
conceptSummary: Combine conditions with AND (both must be true) and OR (either can be true). Use NOT to exclude.

dialogue.text: ShopIndia's fraud team flagged some suspicious UPI transactions over ₹10,000. AND they need to exclude refunded ones.
WHERE with AND. You can chain multiple conditions. Both conditions must be TRUE for a row to appear.

teachMoment.title: AND, OR, NOT in WHERE
teachMoment.body:
Chain conditions:

WHERE payment_method = 'UPI' AND total_amount > 10000
WHERE city = 'Mumbai' OR city = 'Delhi'
WHERE NOT status = 'refunded'

• AND: BOTH must be true
• OR: EITHER can be true
• NOT: reverse the condition

task.instruction: Find all completed transactions paid via UPI with total_amount greater than 5000. Show txn_id, total_amount, payment_method, and status.
task.startingQuery:
SELECT txn_id, total_amount, payment_method, status
FROM transactions
WHERE
task.solution: SELECT txn_id, total_amount, payment_method, status FROM transactions WHERE payment_method = 'UPI' AND total_amount > 5000 AND status = 'completed'

hints.text: You need THREE conditions joined with AND. What are they?
WHERE payment_method = 'UPI' AND total_amount > 5000 AND status = 'completed'
Full query: SELECT txn_id, total_amount, payment_method, status FROM transactions WHERE payment_method = 'UPI' AND total_amount > 5000 AND status = 'completed'

winDialogue.text: 2 suspicious high-value UPI transactions. Both paid by customer 201 — Aditya Shah from Mumbai!
Aditya Shah is a Gold loyalty member with 12 orders. High value, high frequency. Possible inside connection.

storyBeat: Aditya Shah keeps appearing in the data. Gold loyalty member, frequent buyer, and now flagged transactions. Is he the mastermind, or just a patsy?
